placements.why: The directives to forget and remove specific knowledge domains name an organizational governance concern — the active management of what knowledge the organization retains versus erases — that nothing in existing strata or structure covers.
placements.title: Managing what knowledge persists and what gets erased
placements.theme: Organizational decisions about which knowledge domains to retain, remove, or forget.

placements.title: Knowledge erasure by directive
placements.theme: Specific knowledge domains are targeted for active removal or forgetting through explicit organizational directives.
placements.why: Both segments are directives from Xena ExpertGH commanding the elimination of specific knowledge — the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet with its helium procurement contracts, and zeppelin routes — cohering as a thematic subject of directed knowledge erasure that future envelopes may continue to feed.
